items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: Interviewer mentions sending Peter Gennaro to Pete; Interviewee does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Pete.

ctx.x: and he wouldn't do it I had a medley of his hits done the kind of thing you open up with or close with that kind of thing you never would learn that
there was a great dancer in New Orleans Peter Gennaro and I sent him to Pete
to learn stage presence to dance and all that
